sam.title: Instant top-up through Sam
sam.description: Transfer from your wallet to the store's wallet through Sam, and your balance is credited automatically once the transfer is confirmed.
sam.payDescription: Open the payment page and transfer the amount shown. This page updates on its own once the transfer arrives.
sam.waitingDescription: Once you have transferred, come back to this page. We check every few seconds — there is no need to keep the payment page open.
sam.stillPending: The transfer has not arrived yet.
sam.referenceHint: If the transfer is not noticed automatically, enter the transaction number from your wallet app and Sam will look for it.
sam.creditedDescription: The amount is in your wallet and ready to spend.
sam.reviewDescription: Your transfer arrived and was confirmed. Every payment is reviewed before crediting, and it will appear in your wallet once approved.
sam.expiredDescription: This invoice expired before the transfer arrived. If you did pay, contact us with the transaction reference; otherwise start a new top-up.

errors.invalid_input: Check the amount and try again.
errors.not_configured: Instant payment is unavailable right now. Use a manual transfer below.
errors.method_unavailable: That wallet is unavailable right now.
errors.too_many: You have too many open top-up requests. Finish one or wait for review.
errors.suspended: Your account is temporarily suspended from topping up.
errors.wallet_problem: There is a problem with the store's payment setup. Let us know and we will fix it.
errors.provider_unavailable: The payment service is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
errors.expired: The invoice expired. Start a new top-up.
errors.not_found: We could not find that invoice.
errors.not_paid: Sam found no transfer with that reference. Check the number and that the transfer completed.
errors.short_payment: The transferred amount is less than the invoice. Contact us to settle the difference.
errors.unknown: Could not complete that. Try again.
